newsitem.title: UK: UK's Clarke - leaked data show joblessness falling.
newsitem.headline: UK's Clarke - leaked data show joblessness falling.

text.p: Britain's Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke said on Wednesday that a leaked report on January unemployment showed British joblessness continuing to fall.
Clarke also said the report, leaked to a UK newspaper, would be "very bad news" for the opposition Labour party.
"It shows unemployment coming down again," he told GMTV Television.
The leaked report, published in a Britain's Daily Mirror, said unemployment fell by a seasonally-adjusted 57,800 in January -- almost double market expectations.
The Office for National Statistics, which is due to release official jobs numbers at 0930 GMT, declined to comment on the leak.
